questions.stem: An energy level diagram shows products at a higher energy level than reactants with ΔH = +92 kJ/mol. What type of reaction does this represent?

options.text: Endothermic, because products have more energy than reactants
Exothermic, because the ΔH value is large

questions.explanation: When products are at a higher energy level than reactants, the reaction is endothermic. The positive ΔH value (+92 kJ/mol) confirms that energy has been absorbed from the surroundings and stored in the products.
